message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Overview** | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• On highways: 55–75 mph (varies by county).
• In cities: 25–35 mph.
• School zones: 20 mph during school hours. | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % for drivers 21+.
• Lower BAC limits for commercial drivers and those under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | | **Cell Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • Stop at red lights and stop signs.
• Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• At four‑way stops, the first vehicle to arrive has the right of way. | | **Lane Discipline** | • Keep to the right lane unless passing.
• Use turn signals at least 100 ft before turning. | | **School Bus** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children. | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a fire hydrant.
• No parking on sidewalks or in crosswalks. | | **Towing & Vehicle Registration** | • Vehicles must display valid registration stickers.
• Towing vehicles must have proper permits. | | **Vehicle Inspection** | • Annual safety inspection required for most vehicles. | | **Traffic Cameras & Speed Cameras** | • Speed cameras are used in many counties; fines are issued automatically. | ### How to Find Specific Laws 1. **Texas Transportation Code** – The primary source for all traffic statutes. 2. **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV)** – Provides driver’s handbook and updates. 3. **County Sheriff’s Office** – Local ordinances may add additional restrictions. If you need details on a particular law or recent changes, let me know!
